title: p03 totem
description: you can now hold p03 from inscryption in your minecraft world, and he'll save you from dying. hooray!
body: this is a simple retexturing of a totem of undying, turned into p03 from incryption. shows up in both your hotbar and during the animation, although the particles havent been changed. simply put the zip into your resource pack folder and enjoy : )
